angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,419,228 km at 92.04 pc = 0.21 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.8643 +/- 0.0180 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 92.04 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 2.04 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Zhang et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 118203 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..295Z/abstract): 1,419,228 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.27 +/- 0.028 solar masses from Zhang et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 118203 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..295Z/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5742 +/- 93 K from Zhang et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 118203 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..295Z/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Zhang et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 118203 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..295Z/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-118203.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.923, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 118203 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 IV, from Maciejewski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A.172M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 118203 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.287 dex, from Zhang et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..295Z/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 118203 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.6458, from Castro-González et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A.160C/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 118203 (pscomppars): age 4.73 Gyr, from Zhang et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..295Z/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 118203 (pscomppars): rotation period 23.1 d, from Zhang et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..295Z/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 118203 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 5.89 km/s, from Zhang et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..295Z/abstract)
